standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: Hello again. How can I help you?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.player: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.player: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?

steps.npc: I'm afraid I only had the one.
Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!

steps.player: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?

steps.npc: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.npc: You don't seem to have enough money for it.

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:
The High Priest hands you a Circlet of Water in exchange for 10,000 coins.

steps.npc: Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.

using-items-on-him-potion.npc: Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?

using-items-on-him-potion.player: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.

using-items-on-him-potion.npc: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.

using-items-on-him-potion.player: Sorry, I was just trying to help.

using-items-on-him-eldritch-ashes.player: Hey there. I was wondering if you could do me a favour?

using-items-on-him-eldritch-ashes.text: You show the ashes to the High Priest.

using-items-on-him-eldritch-ashes.player: I know cremation isn't your way, but is there anything you could do with these ashes?

using-items-on-him-eldritch-ashes.npc: Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.

using-items-on-him-eldritch-ashes.player: That's all I ask. Thank you.

using-items-on-him-eldritch-ashes.text: You give the ashes to the High Priest.
